"""
groq_item.py

Pure in-memory FastAPI module exposing a single POST /items endpoint to
create (post) a new item. No database, no ORM — state is kept in-module
using an in-memory list and an auto-incrementing ID counter.

Usage:
    from fastapi import FastAPI
    from groq_item import router as items_router

    app = FastAPI()
    app.include_router(items_router)

Run:
    uvicorn groq_item:app --reload
"""
